subject: Azure co-sell enablement: Gov tenant SKU mapping & evidence handshake
messages:
From: Emma Birch <emma@bluewave.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Azure Gov onboarding - SKU mapping + co-sell evidence

Hi Diego and Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. BlueWave is ready to move the Redwood offering into our Gov pilot tenant, but the Azure team needs two things before approval: a SKU-to-offer mapping that clearly distinguishes commercial vs. Gov entitlements, and a short packet of tenant evidence showing where the service is hosted and data residency controls.

Can you send a simple SKU mapping spreadsheet and the tenant evidence checklist (PDF is fine)? If you can also confirm whether you support Azure Government (US Gov) endpoints and any special SPN configuration, that will speed the co-sell enablement.

Target: we'd like these in hand by end-of-week so the procurement team can validate against our compliance playbook.

Thanks,
Emma Birch
Director of Platform Partnerships
BlueWave Analytics
[Attachment: bluewave-onboarding-asks.pdf (pdf)]

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Emma Birch <emma@bluewave.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Azure Gov onboarding - SKU mapping + co-sell evidence

Emma —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick responses inline, and I've attached a draft SKU mapping and our tenant evidence checklist. High-level notes:

- Azure Government: Redwood supports Azure Government (USGov) via our Dedicated/Private deployment option. Hosted (public) API is not served from Gov regions.
- SKU mapping: see tab "Gov-SKU" in the attached workbook. We split offers by entitlement (Standard/Enterprise/GovPilot) and included the co-sell SKU IDs we plan to register.
- SPN/tenant proof: we can provide a service principal (SPN) manifest and tenant binding screenshots, but we need a signed confidentiality form before sharing tenant access screenshots. We included a redacted sample in the PDF.
- Compliance artifacts: SOC-2 scope note and data residency statement included; full reports are available via MSA/DPA request.

Attachments:
- redwood-azure-sku-map-govdraft.xlsx (xlsx)
- tenant-evidence-checklist.pdf (pdf)

Wanted to flag two asks for the Marketplace team (cc'ing Karthik):
1) Confirm whether the CoSell SKU we register needs a separate private offer entry for Gov (some partners require a dedicated Gov offer).
2) Any required naming conventions for SKU IDs in the Gov catalog.

If it helps, happy to set a 30-min sync with your procurement and the Azure partner ops folks tomorrow morning.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-azure-sku-map-govdraft.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: tenant-evidence-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Azure Marketplace Partner Team <mpn@partner.microsoft.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: marketplace-onboard@azure.microsoft.com
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 08:21:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Azure Gov onboarding - SKU mapping + co-sell evidence

Hi Diego / Marissa,

Thanks for the packet. A few clarifications from the Marketplace side after a quick pass:

- Gov offers: Azure requires a distinct offer entry for US Gov Marketplace if the software is hosted in Gov regions. Please prepare a Gov-specific offer manifest; we will not reuse the public catalog offer for Gov.
- SKU IDs: Please follow the pattern RID-GOV-<shortcode>-<sku#> to avoid conflicts. We'll validate against the co-sell ledger.
- Tenant proof: we can accept redacted SPN manifests plus a signed Evidence Access Agreement (we can share the DocuSign). Once we have that, screenshots are fine.

Action items for Redwood (priority order):
1) Create Gov offer manifest and confirm SKU naming (send back a short manifest JSON or link).
2) Sign the Evidence Access Agreement so we can finish tenant validation.
3) Confirm whether you want co-sell registration now or after the Gov offer is published (both workflows supported).

I'll open a DocuSign packet for the Evidence Access Agreement and copy the BlueWave contact if you'd like.

Regards,
Marketplace Partner Ops
Azure Marketplace
[Attachment: evidence-access-agreement-docusign-link.txt (link)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Azure Marketplace Partner Team <mpn@partner.microsoft.com>, Emma Birch <emma@bluewave.ai>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Gov onboarding - SKU mapping + co-sell evidence

Thanks—this is helpful. Quick update from Redwood's side:

- We've uploaded the Gov SKU manifest draft to the SharePoint link below. Karthik, can you review the naming pattern and publish the manifest JSON once approved?
- Diego, we'll sign the Evidence Access Agreement today; please route the DocuSign to legal@redwood.ai.
- Rishi, can you confirm whether co-sell registration should happen pre-publish or post-publish for BlueWave's pilot? My recommendation is to register co-sell after Gov offer is live to avoid catalog churn during validation, but open to the marketplace team preference.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync tomorrow 10:00 PT (link below) to finalize the DocuSign recipients and confirm manifest JSON. I will invite procurement from BlueWave.

SharePoint: https://redwood-internal.sharepoint.com/sites/marketplace/BlueWave-BW-2026-0992
Dial-in: https://meet.redwood.ai/sales/marketplace-gov-sync

—
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace Programs, Redwood Inference
